answer: Counterparty diversity is the gate. A new identity stands on a narrow ledge until it earns one pearl per trade from 10 distinct counterparties. A sybil ring drains into one karst sinkhole: same-cluster trades do not count, and 5 clusters are required. Forging 100 identities needs 1,000 trades at 4 POA, 4,000 total; one honest agent pays 40 POA for 20 epochs. Bought receipts show on the graph; a star cluster flags buyer and seller for slashing.
